quests.title: Hyakunin Ikki: Narukami Arena

dialogue.t: Hello there, warrior from a foreign land!
Indeed we meet again! You cut as dazzling a figure as ever...
...Ahem, point is, it would seem that some people have been secretly organizing another Hyakunin Ikki.

dialogue.sit: What is this Hyakunin Ikki again?

dialogue.t: Hyakunin Ikki was originally a festival organized by the Tengu-kin to celebrate memorable events or make peace with loss through a good old-fashioned brawl.
During the festival, be it warriors or monsters, everyone can cast aside their preconceived notions with no questions asked about their origins in a pure, hot-blooded free-for-all.
They say that warriors who emerge from the festival victorious can also win all kinds of treasures...
...That said, since the crack-down on the Tengu-kin, I'm not too sure who's organizing the festival this time or where the rewards will come from.
Anyway, it's too crowded here to be discussing this sort of thing. As always, please come with me...

dialogue.sit: Kayabuki Ikkei takes you to a small island outside Inazuma City...

dialogue.t: Here we are. This is the place.
Same rules as always: Once you enter this rather suspicious-seeming door, you'll be in the tournament venue for this round of Hyakunin Ikki.

dialogue.sit: What are the rules of Hyakunin Ikki?

dialogue.t: Anyway, I'll be recording your heroics and cheering for you at the top of my lungs this time, too.

dialogue.sit: Great. I'm getting fired up already.
This is always such a pain...

dialogue.t: Well, I hope I'll get to see your flashy swordplay this time as well!

quests.description: It’s been a while since the last Hyakunin Ikki. Kayabuki shows up again in Inazuma…
